description: Clark travel cover prompts. Substitute current-project wording and subjects; references remain style-only.
candidate_common: Create one finished 16:9 travel vlog cover. Image 1 is STYLE ONLY: match its warm cream bold slightly slanted brush-edged Chinese lettering, small navy brush label, restrained yellow underline and tilted thin white photo-card. Do not copy its people, scenery or old wording. Image 2 is the actual current-trip {hero_subject} photograph, the main visual. Image 3 is the actual current-trip couple photograph, a supporting white-bordered photo-card. Exact text only: label '{label}', main title '{title}', subtitle '{subtitle}'. Keep the location and weather faithful, actual faces, identities, clothing, expressions and hand gesture intact. Do not invent scenery or beautify people. Give main subject and title distinct space, readable at thumbnail size; keep key content inside generous margins and away from bottom-right duration badge. Use the reference style as a series identity. No extra text, dates, 4K marks, logos, arrows, technical words or watermarks. {composition_notes}
variant_common: Create one finished travel vlog cover as a matching aspect-ratio edition of image 1, the USER-SELECTED cover. Preserve its approved palette, bold slightly slanted cream brush-edged Chinese typography, small navy brush label, restrained yellow accents and tilted slim white photo-card. Exact words only: label '{label}', main title '{title}', subtitle '{subtitle}'. Image 2 is the original actual {hero_subject} photograph; image 3 is the actual couple photograph. Preserve true faces, identities, clothing, expressions, pose, hands, animal anatomy, landmark contours, real scene and weather. No invented scenery or beautification. Use current-trip photos, not people from the old style example. Recompose natively for required ratio; do not stretch or simply crop the selected cover. Maintain readable hierarchy and comfortable margins. No additional text or logos. {composition_notes}

layouts.16:9: Output a 16:9 horizontal edition. If image 1 already is the selected horizontal cover and no edits are requested, retain that file instead of generating again. Otherwise keep large title upper-left, large hero on right, and smaller actual couple card lower-left, with all faces, essential gesture, hero features and text intact. Adapt these positions to the selected design instead of imposing a new layout.
layouts.4:3: Output exactly 4:3 LANDSCAPE. Keep horizontal edition's layout identity: title upper-left, hero right, couple card lower-left. Redistribute their scale and spacing so subtitle, all faces and essential hero features fit, without cropping away important information. Avoid text-card overlap.
layouts.3:4: Output exactly 3:4 PORTRAIT. Place label and large title near top, subtitle just below. Main hero dominates middle/right, couple card near lower-left. Wrap title into two lines only if needed for its actual length; retain every exact character and readable type. Keep both faces and meaningful gesture complete. Separate title, hero features and photo-card; avoid cramped layers.
layouts.9:16: Output exactly 9:16 TALL PORTRAIT. Use roughly upper 30% for label, title and subtitle, middle for the main hero, lower-left/center for the actual couple photo-card. Title may wrap naturally without changing words. Keep title, hero eyes or landmark features, both faces and essential gesture distinct. Keep important content within central 80% width and above bottom 10% where possible. A coherent tall design, not a cropped landscape cover.
